critique: The live canvas maze carries the brief well: a single vermilion square carves an 11×15 grid on the tilted paper sheet, then a thick 9px red solver line threads it, echoing the red channel in the photographed black-and-red wall maze above. The cream ground, sharp red diagonal bar and counter-tilted sheets also keep it high-key and Constructivist without darkness or haze. What weakens it is the missing agitprop: there is no heroic typography, only a small monospace date, so the slogan the style calls for is absent. The photo of an already-finished maze also upstages the self-carving one, the canvas is drawn at half resolution and stretched 2× so its walls look soft, and the 17px half-hidden guinea pig is a stray leftover that should be cut rather than covered.
